ruleDefinitions.name: ESXi System Information Discovery Via ESXCLI
ruleDefinitions.description: Detects execution of the "esxcli" command with the "system" flag in order to retrieve information about the different component of the system. Such as accounts, modules, NTP, etc.

sequences.query: ((process_path = RGX("\\/esxcli$") AND process_command_line = RGX(".*system.*")) AND (process_command_line = RGX(".*\\ get.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\ list.*")))
